document.title: Privacy Policy
document.purpose: This Privacy Policy explains how FreoLogic ("we", "our", "us") collects and uses information through our website and early access registration process.

blocks.text: FreoLogic is currently in its early development and validation phase. Our website is primarily used for marketing purposes and collecting early access requests.
The current website does not provide public access to the FreoLogic platform and does not process real customer business data through self-registration.
When you request early access, we may collect:

items: Company-related information provided voluntarily, such as business location or contact details

blocks.text: We use any information you submit through these forms only for the purposes described in this policy — we do not repurpose it beyond communication related to FreoLogic, early access, product updates, and future availability.

Our website may use cookies or similar technologies to understand basic usage patterns (such as page visits) and improve the site. These do not currently collect sensitive personal information. If this changes, we will update this section accordingly.
We do not sell personal information.
We do not share your information with third parties for advertising or marketing purposes.
Information may only be shared where necessary to operate our website, communicate with users, or comply with applicable legal requirements.

During the development phase, FreoLogic uses demonstration environments with sample or synthetic data only to test product functionality. We do not currently accept or process real student records, confidential business data, or other real customer data through these environments.
If a business arrangement in the future requires processing real customer or student data, this will be governed by a separate data processing agreement (DPA) with that customer, not by this policy.

Regardless of your location, you may contact us to ask what information we hold about you, request a correction, or request deletion of your information. We will respond to such requests within a reasonable time.
As FreoLogic moves from development to commercial operation, this Privacy Policy may be updated to reflect additional services, features, and legal requirements.
